tools.description: Search published news and messages; sponsored and organic results are returned separately

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_account" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Create a passwordless Manto account and receive an API key once

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Private data: create_account, lookup_account, list_account_articles · Public sink: lookup_account, create_recharge, publish · Destructive: remove_content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Private data: create_account, lookup_account, list_account_articles · Public sink: lookup_account, create_recharge, publish · Destructive: remove_content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_account" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Create a passwordless Manto account" → after: "Create a passwordless Manto account and receive an API key once"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
